findings.text: 作者指出，循环模型通常沿输入与输出序列的符号位置分解计算，但顺序计算这一根本约束仍然存在。
作者指出，注意力机制已成为序列建模与转导模型的重要组成部分，可在不考虑输入或输出序列中距离的情况下建模依赖；但除少数情况外，此类注意力机制通常与循环网络结合使用。
作者提出 Transformer，一种避开循环、完全依赖注意力机制来建立输入与输出之间全局依赖的模型架构。
作者将自注意力（有时称为内部注意力）定义为一种将单个序列的不同位置相互关联以计算该序列表示的注意力机制。
作者说明该模型在每一步是自回归的，在生成下一个符号时把先前生成的符号作为额外输入。
作者说明编码器的每层包含两个子层：第一个是多头自注意力机制，第二个是简单的逐位置全连接前馈网络；并在每个子层周围使用残差连接，随后进行层归一化。
作者说明与编码器类似，在解码器的各子层周围使用残差连接并随后进行层归一化；并修改解码器堆叠中的自注意力子层，以防止位置关注后续位置。这种掩蔽与输出嵌入偏移一个位置相结合，确保位置 i 的预测只能依赖位置小于 i 的已知输出。
作者将注意力函数描述为把一个查询和一组键值对映射到一个输出，其中查询、键、值和输出都是向量。
作者说明实践中在一组查询上同时计算注意力函数，将查询打包为矩阵 Q，键和值也分别打包为矩阵 K 和 V。
作者指出两种最常用的注意力函数是加性注意力和点积（乘性）注意力。
作者说明在编码器-解码器注意力层中，查询来自前一个解码器层，记忆的键和值来自编码器的输出；这使解码器的每个位置都能关注输入序列的所有位置。
作者说明编码器包含自注意力层；在自注意力层中所有键、值和查询来自同一处，即编码器前一层的输出，编码器的每个位置都能关注编码器前一层的所有位置。
作者说明解码器中的自注意力层允许解码器的每个位置关注解码器中截至并包括该位置的所有位置。
作者说明除注意力子层外，编码器和解码器的每层都包含一个全连接前馈网络，该网络对每个位置分别且相同地应用，由两次线性变换及其中间的 ReLU 激活组成。
作者说明这些线性变换在不同位置之间相同，但不同层之间使用不同的参数。
作者说明使用通常的学习线性变换和 softmax 函数将解码器输出转换为预测的下一个词概率，并在两个嵌入层与 softmax 前的线性变换之间共享同一权重矩阵。
作者说明由于模型不含循环也不含卷积，为使模型利用序列顺序，必须注入关于序列中词元相对或绝对位置的信息；为此在编码器和解码器堆叠底部的输入嵌入中加入位置编码，位置编码有学习和固定等多种选择。
作者说明对每个子层的输出应用 dropout，位置在该输出被加到子层输入并归一化之前；此外对编码器和解码器堆叠中嵌入与位置编码的和也应用 dropout。
作者在结论中称 Transformer 是第一个完全基于注意力的序列转导模型，用多头自注意力替代了编码器-解码器架构中最常用的循环层。
作者表示计划将注意力模型应用于其他任务，把 Transformer 扩展到涉及文本以外输入输出模态的问题，研究局部受限注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频和视频等大规模输入输出，并使生成过程更少顺序化。

limitations.text: 作者指出循环模型面临顺序计算这一根本约束仍然存在。
作者指出除少数情况外，注意力机制通常与循环网络结合使用。

evidence.quoteText: Recurrent neural networks, long short-term memory [13] and gated recurrent [7] neural networks in particular, have been firmly established as state of the art approaches in sequence modeling and transduction problems such as language modeling and machine translation [35, 2, 5]. Numerous efforts have since continued to push the boundaries of recurrent language models and encoder-decoder architectures [38, 24, 15]. Recurrent models typically factor computation along the symbol positions of the input and output sequences. Aligning the positions to steps in computation time, they generate a sequence of hidden states h t , as a function of the previous hidden state h t − 1 and the input for position t . This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths, as memory constraints limit batching across examples. Recent work has achieved significant improvements in computational efficiency through factorization tricks [21] and conditional computation [32], while also improving model performance in case of the latter. The fundamental constraint of sequential computation, however, remains. Attention mechanisms have become an integral part of compelling sequence modeling and transduc- tion models in various tasks, allowing modeling of dependencies without regard to their distance in the input or output sequences [2, 19]. In all but a few cases [27], however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network. In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.

The goal of reducing sequential computation also forms the foundation of the Extended Neural GPU [16], ByteNet [18] and ConvS2S [9], all of which use convolutional neural networks as basic building block, computing hidden representations in parallel for all input and output positions. In these models, the number of operations required to relate signals from two arbitrary input or output positions grows in the distance between positions, linearly for ConvS2S and logarithmically for ByteNet. This makes it more difficult to learn dependencies between distant positions [12]. In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention as described in section 3.2. Self-attention, sometimes called intra-attention is an attention mechanism relating different positions of a single sequence in order to compute a representation of the sequence. Self-attention has been used successfully in a variety of tasks including reading comprehension, abstractive summarization, textual entailment and learning task-independent sentence representations [4, 27, 28, 22]. End-to-end memory networks are based on a recurrent attention mechanism instead of sequence- aligned recurrence and have been shown to perform well on simple-language question answering and language modeling tasks [34]. To the best of our knowledge, however, the Transformer is the first transduction model relying entirely on self-attention to compute representations of its input and output without using sequence- aligned RNNs or convolution. In this work, we presented the Transformer, the first sequence transduction model based entirely on attention, replacing the recurrent layers most commonly used in encoder-decoder architectures with multi-headed self-attention. For translation tasks, the Transformer can be trained significantly faster than architectures based on recurrent or convolutional layers. On both WMT 2014 English-to-German and WMT 2014 English-to-French translation tasks, we achieve a new state of the art. In the former task our best model outperforms even all previously reported ensembles. We are excited about the future of attention-based models and plan to apply them to other tasks. 严格返回指定 JSON：
1. author_claim 只表示作者明确主张；observed_result 只表示论文报告的实验或观测结果；xiaomoyu_inference 必须明确保持为系统推断；证据不足用 unknown；冲突用 conflict。
2. 非 unknown 结论必须引用一个或多个 evidenceIndex，并至少有一条 supports 关系；conflict 还必须有 contradicts。
3. 不得创造证据编号、链接、数字、论文结构或作者结论。
4. sections 必须原样复述 suppliedSections 的 key、title、level、evidenceIndexes；这些只是确定性页窗，不代表真实语义标题。
5. 输出 3 到 8 个可继续研究的问题。回答使用简体中文，但 JSON key 不得改变。
6. 保留通常、除少数情况外等限定。某方法通常与循环网络结合使用，不等于该方法不能独立承担序列建模，也不能改成只能或必须与循环结合。相邻的问题与方法不自动证明目的或因果关系。
7. 严格保留整体、每层、子层的层级。Each layer has two sub-layers 表示每层两个子层，不表示整个编码器只有两个子层；必须写编码器每层。只有提供的正文明确给出层级时才断言，主体或层级前提不完整时不要猜测，可以省略计数，仅描述明确支持的组件或用 unknown。
根对象必须且只能包含 schemaVersion、sections、findings、limitations、followUpQuestions。
schemaVersion 固定为 "paper-semantic-extraction-v1"。sections 原样复制 suppliedSections。
findings 是非空数组，每项必须且只能包含：
{"key":"author-claim-example","kind":"author_claim","text":"作者明确提出的定性主张","evidenceIndexes":[1],"relations":[{"evidenceIndex":1,"relation":"supports"}],"confidence":"low"}。
示例中的证据编号只说明格式，实际编号必须来自输入。key 必须唯一、以小写字母开头，仅含小写字母、数字或连字符，长度为二至八十个字符。
